# Short-term forecasts

Catch advice is based on short-term forecasts: the stock is projected from the assessment through one or more
intermediate years (status quo F or a known catch) into the advice year under alternative F (or catch) scenarios.
With SS3 the scenarios are run as forecasts in `forecast.ss` (fixed F by fleet and season, scaled from the F basis
of the advice to apical F; see the FLRef workflow and `ss3diags::SSnewrun()`), and the runs are read with
`r4ss::SSgetoutput()`. ss3diags2 takes it from there: `ss3_fwd()` converts the runs into `FLStockR` objects (MLE or
MVLN draws), `ss3plot_fwd()` plots the scenarios with or without uncertainty, and `ss3_fwdtable()` summarises the
fishing opportunities.

The example is European hake in GSAs 12-16 (reference year 2024) with three F scenarios: the advice F (Fadv),
status quo F (Fsq) and no fishing (F0), after two intermediate years at Fsq (2025-2026):

```{r fwd}
fw <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "hke.37.12-16", "hke.37.12-16_fwd.rds", package = "ss3diags2"))
names(fw)
fs <- ss3_fwd(fw)                                  # MLE
```

```{r fwd-plot, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 9}
ss3plot_fwd(fs, ci = FALSE)
```

With uncertainty from MVLN draws of each run (here to 2029):

```{r fwd-ci, fig.height = 6, fig.width = 9}
fi <- ss3_fwd(fw, output = "iters", iters = 1000)
ss3plot_fwd(fi, end = 2029)
```

The agreed benchmarks can replace the SS3 reference points (`refpts =`), and the fishing opportunities table gives
catch and F in the advice year (the first year in which the scenarios differ, 2027), SSB at the start of the next
year, its change and the probability of SSB below Blim:

```{r fwd-table}
bms <- FLCore::FLPar(Ftgt = 0.285, Btgt = 6640, Bpa = 3320, Blim = 1660)   # illustration
fb <- ss3_fwd(fw, refpts = bms, output = "iters", iters = 1000)
ss3_fwdtable(fb)
```

> **Reading the forecast plot.** The black line and bands are the assessment, the coloured lines the scenarios
> from the end year (2024, first dashed line) on. Between the dashed lines are the intermediate years, in which all
> scenarios fish at status quo F, so they overlap; the scenarios separate in the advice year (2027). SSB responds
> one year later (SSB at the start of 2028 reflects the catch of 2027), which is why the table reports SSB of the
> year after the advice year. Uncertainty bands come from the MVLN draws of each forecast run and widen with the
> horizon; catch is a model output without its own uncertainty in this approximation.
